observations: The page number «53» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The page has no signature. L01-L08 end the computation after al-Battānī begun on p. 52 (JP2 0084, L17-L32), which ends «gibt :». L09: «2. Nach Al-Khwārizmī.», centred, the name spaced.

L01-L07 and L10-L21: the computations, set as tables: the names are joined to the figures by dotted leaders (L01, L02, L04, L13-L15, L19, L20), which are not transcribed; the figures stand in a column after a column of «=»; L03, L05, L07, L12, L17 and L21 stand below short rules under the figures; L03 and L06 have no «=», and L21 «addiert :» none; in L11 the ditto marks „ stand under «Mittlere» and «Länge»; «Apogeum», «addiert :», «Anomalie (Argumentum)», «Centrum», «subtrahiert :» and «addiert :» are set further to the right than the other names. Each printed row is one line here, the cells separated by our «|»; the empty cells give the columns room and are not printed.
L01-L08. Checked: 144° 5′ 20″ + 6° 14′ 20″ = 150° 19′ 40″; + 248° 30′ = 398° 49′ 40″, written 398° 50′, the seconds rounded as note 1 says; less 360° 38° 50′, which is 8° 50′ of Taurus (from 30°).

L10-L28. Checked: 131° 1′ is the mean longitude of the sun of p. 42 (JP2 0074, L28), 131° 0′ 34″, rounded (note 1); 131° 1′ − 26° 33′ = 104° 28′; 386° 33′ − 242° 5′ = 144° 28′; 144° 28′ − 4° 56′ 30″ = 139° 31′ 30″; 104° 28′ + 4° 56′ 30″ = 109° 24′ 30″; 139° 31′ 30″ + 5° 35′ 35″ = 145° 7′ 5″, written 145° 7′; 145° 7′ + 242° 5′ = 387° 12′, less 360° 27° 12′, which is 27° 12′ of Aries. The two true longitudes, 38° 50′ and 27° 12′, differ by 11° 38′, of which 9° 40′ is the difference of the two mean longitudes, 396° 13′ and 386° 33′ (see p. 41, JP2 0073, L31-L38, and p. 50, JP2 0082, L36-L39). The values taken from Tables 9-10 and 30-31 are to be compared with the tables.

L14: «Sublimatio (Apogeum) definita», where L26 and p. 50 (JP2 0082, L08) have «Sublimatio examinata». L02: «anomal.corr.», set close: the gap after the point of «anomal.» measures 6-7 px, where the word space after «Aequat.» measures 22 px. L06: «—360°», the dash set close to the figures (5 px), where p. 45 (JP2 0077, L29) sets «— 360°» with a gap of 16 px.
N08: a speck above the final a of «Anomalia»; not transcribed. Spaced type, marked {sp:}: «Al-Khwārizmī», «Kh.»; italics: «wahre Länge» (L07, L26), «elheza» (L23, N04).
The colons and the semicolon stand after the thin space of the edition (12-17 px measured).
